title: Rabbi Ralph Tawil: Dayenu- "The Way to Thank"

chapters.title: The Seder Night as a Night of Education
chapters.about: Education, children, questions, and experiential learning

chapters.title: Handling Different Reading Speeds at the Table
chapters.about: Telling the story versus reading the Haggadah

summary: Rabbi Tawil discusses the educational goals of the Seder night, emphasizing the importance of asking questions, telling the story rather than just reading the Haggadah, and using experiential methods. He also explores the section of V'hi Sheamdah as the secret of Jewish survival and the meaning of Dayenu in recognizing the steps of a process.
questions: How should we teach children during the Seder?
Why do we raise our wine glasses during V'hi Sheamdah?
What is the meaning of saying Dayenu?
How does the Seder ensure the survival of the Jewish people?
